game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market, a forest mushroom market: the forest ranger must hold off shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Filter Harvest: Combine for and if to harvest only healing herbs that meet a rule.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market: a forest mushroom market
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Market, repeat each round: Combine for and if to harvest only healing herbs that meet a rule. Then check harvest and advance.
player_objective: Protect the seed vault from shadow wolves in Mushroom Market: keep harvest above zero until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Filter Harvest
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 5, Level 10, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
